Specifications:

  • Stock Number: 500654BKZ
  • Capacity: 5000mAh
  • Voltage: 14.8V / 4-Cell / 4S1P
  • Discharge Rate: 65C Continual / 130C Burst
  • Charge Rate: 5C Max
  • Size(1-5mm difference): 38X51X147mm
  • Approx Weight(±5g) : 562g
  • Output Connector: XT90
  • Balance Connector: JST / XH
  • Wire (AWG): 10#
  • Package included: 1* CNHL Black Series 5000mAh 14.8V 4S Lipo Battery 65C with XT90 Plug

Compatible RC Models:

CNHL 4s lipo battery 5000mAh 14.8v with XT90 plug is specially designed for RC cars, trucks, helicopters, aircraft and boats. Mainly compatible with Super Sonicwake 48” RTR, TLR04012, TLR04011, and TLR04009.

Notice:

  • For the RC battery, only if the voltage and the plug match, then it will fit.
  • Please stop charging immediately when the cell voltage has been charged to 4.2V (Normal cell voltage is between 3.7V~4.2V).
  • To double make sure safe, please check first whether the battery surface is alright when you get it and whether the voltage is normal before using.
  • If the new battery won’t hold a full charge or loss the charge very quickly in a short time, please use the Balance Charger to charge and recycle several times first.

CNHL LiPo batteries come with a 90-day warranty from the date of purchase, unless otherwise stated in the product listing.

This warranty covers original defects in materials and workmanship. It does not cover normal wear and tear, puffing, swelling, over-disacharge, over-charge, improper storage, crash or water damage, connector changes, or any damage resulting from misuse or mishandling.

If you find that a battery purchased from us is defective within the 90-day warranty period, please get in touch with us to arrange a return for inspection. Based on our evaluation, we will usually repair, replace, or offer an appropriate solution at no additional charge.
